title: Solace
physical_identity: A quiet house overlooking vast mountain ranges, with carpet, porcelain pitchers, crumbling-painted doorways, etched windows and dust that only asks to be swept; framed as a refuge from war.
scale_topology: One house; extent beyond it not stated.
anomalies: a refuge free of war inside a reality described as perverted
silence and stillness that do not remember fear
lighting_sound: Silence and stillness; lighting not stated.
signature_mechanic: A small silent memorial house with a mountain view where the dust asks only to be swept; atmosphere not conflict.
conflicts_notes: Bilingual English/Arabic prose; Arabic is stated to be a direct translation. Author's note says it draws on the author's own experience. No structural sections or exit data.

key_quotes.quote: it is a direct translation of the English text above it
Stay here a while, without having to worry about anything.
This is a house. It overlooks the vast ranges of mountains.
it only asks to be swept
You will not see home again.
